title: M6 switch proposal plus artifact-local rollback dry-run
instructions: Read the accepted M3 rollback artifact, accepted M5 quality gate artifact, and clean manifest whose status must be quality-passed. Generate a switch proposal for daily_basic/month=2026-05 targeting the quality-passed clean version. The switch grain is dataset/window unless existing adapter code proves deterministic mixed routing; if deterministic mixed routing cannot be proven, mark the proposal blocked for production switch or require a whole-dataset switch decision. Do not modify production metadata/query-entry/daily_basic.json. Run rollback dry-run only with artifact-local candidate pointer files under .ai-coord/artifacts/formal-duckdb-migration/rollback-dry-run, simulating old -> proposed -> old restoration. Record that old query-entry pointer is absent if absent. Proposal must state M7 production switch still needs separate human approval. Write switch proposal and rollback dry-run artifacts, then finish the task for Claude review. After M6 is accepted, stop; do not create M7.
summary: M6 switch proposal and rollback dry-run completed for daily_basic month=2026-05. Read accepted M3 rollback, accepted M5 quality gate, and quality-passed clean manifest. Generated switch proposal targeting the quality-passed clean version; proposal marks production switch blocked pending routing decision because no deterministic dataset/window mixed-routing adapter is proven. Ran artifact-local rollback dry-run with candidate old/new/restored pointer files, simulating absent -> proposed candidate -> absent; restored state matches old. No production metadata/query-entry/daily_basic.json write, no _current.json write, no data-clean/Parquet/source writes, and no M7+ task files created. M7 still requires separate human approval and routing decision.
